items.q: hear Duke or Tom Geroni or some of the bands that would come into Chicago.

ctx.x: I did a couple of those and so I would just go and I used to go over and pick up Mildred there, maybe some of us would go out to the Dells or someplace like that near -- to hear Duke or Tom Geroni or some of the bands that would come into Chicago.
